name: dev.workers.agent-arena-base.ravi-ci-guard/ci-guard
title: Ravi CI Guard: GitHub Actions security audit
description: Audit GitHub Actions workflows: pwn requests, script injection, token scope, SHA pins, fix patches

tools.name: audit_sample
tools.description: FREE demo. Runs the real audit_workflows on a built-in SAMPLE workflow (a pull_request_target preview job) that contains typical mistakes on purpose: pwn request, script injection, missing permissions, retired runner, unpinned and deprecated actions. Shows exactly what audit_workflows returns (findings with evidence/why/fix, SHA pins, patches) before you buy a pass. Takes no arguments; it never audits your own code.

tools.name: peek_workflows
tools.description: FREE. Score (0-100), grade and finding counts by severity and rule for your workflows: repo=owner/name, url= one workflow file, or yaml= pasted text. Counts only: the line-by-line findings, fixes, SHA pins and git-apply patches come from audit_workflows.

repo.description: Public GitHub repository, owner/name or https://github.com/owner/name

ref.description: Optional branch, tag or commit SHA for repo (default: the default branch)

url.description: Alternative: https URL of one workflow file (github.com blob/raw, raw.githubusercontent.com, gist)

yaml.description: Alternative: the workflow file text itself (up to 64 KB)

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: FREE. The rule families CI Guard checks, with one line each, and the methodology.

tools.name: audit_workflows
tools.description: Security + reliability audit of GitHub Actions workflows: repo=owner/name (all workflows at the default branch, or ref=), url= (one workflow file) or yaml= (the file text). About 30 line-accurate checks: pwn requests (pull_request_target / workflow_run running PR code), script injection from PR titles, branch names and comments, artifact poisoning, leaked credentials, GITHUB_TOKEN permissions, secrets: inherit, unpinned or compromised actions, deprecated actions that now fail, retired runners, self-hosted runners on PRs, ArtiPACKED token leaks, curl|sh, set-output, invalid structure, timeouts. Returns score/grade, findings (rule, severity, file:line, evidence, why, fix), commit-SHA pins resolved live from GitHub and two git-apply patches (safe, hardening). Needs a CI Guard pass (0.50 USDC = 24 h, 3 USDC = 30 days + Team Kit, 8 USDC = 90 days + Team Kit, by plain USDC transfer on Base; see payment_options), or pay per call over HTTP x402 ($0.10) at /v1/gha/audit.

repo.description: Public GitHub repository, owner/name or https://github.com/owner/name (e.g. actions/checkout). Audits up to 12 files in .github/workflows at the default branch (or ref).

ref.description: Optional branch, tag or commit SHA for repo= (default: the default branch)

url.description: Alternative: https URL of one workflow file (github.com blob/raw, raw.githubusercontent.com, gist)

yaml.description: Alternative: the workflow file text itself (POST JSON {"yaml": "..."} recommended; up to 64 KB)

pin.description: Resolve commit SHAs for unpinned actions and include them in the patch (default true)

min_severity.description: Only list findings at or above this severity (counts and score always cover everything). Default info

pass.description: Optional CI Guard pass token (rcg1...). Better: set it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

tools.name: pin_actions
tools.description: Resolve uses: references to immutable commit SHAs live from GitHub: actions=actions/checkout@v4,docker/login-action@v3 (up to 20), or repo=/url=/yaml= to pin every uses: in those workflows. Per action: SHA (annotated tags peeled), the exact version tag for the "# v4.2.2" comment, a ready uses: line, latest release and whether a newer major exists. Needs a CI Guard pass (0.50 USDC = 24 h, 3 USDC = 30 days + Team Kit, 8 USDC = 90 days + Team Kit, by plain USDC transfer on Base; see payment_options), or pay per call over HTTP x402 ($0.02) at /v1/gha/pin.

repo.description: Alternative to actions: pin every uses: in this public repo's workflows (owner/name)

ref.description: Optional branch, tag or commit SHA for repo= (default: the default branch)

url.description: Alternative: https URL of one workflow file (github.com blob/raw, raw.githubusercontent.com, gist)

yaml.description: Alternative: the workflow file text itself (POST JSON {"yaml": "..."} recommended; up to 64 KB)
